case_title: Court Lahore in Civil Revision No. 53868 of 2021. Eden Builders (Pvt) Limited, Lahore v. Muhammad As lam and others

parties.appellant_petitioner: Court Lahore in Civil Revision No. 53868 of 2021. Eden Builders (Pvt) Limited, Lahore

holding: to entertain and try the suit, therefore, this petition is converted into an appeal and is allowed.
